description: ESOGU-ML5EV contains cleaned operating measurements from an L5-class electric cargo vehicle in Eskişehir, Türkiye. The university team tested an approximately two-kilometre route at 15, 25 and 35 kilometres per hour under loaded and unloaded conditions. Its public GitHub Data folder lists thirty-five CSV files with one-second observations; the article describes controller-area-network sensor capture. The repository and linked Zenodo release identify Apache License 2.0, with free public access. Coverage is one vehicle and controlled route conditions, not a citywide freight fleet, charging network or long-term battery-degradation survey. Short test loops and load variants limit extrapolation to urban delivery duty cycles. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating vehicle energy use or range constraints in electric-logistics simulations. No related catalogue record was shown to use these exact traces. The Zenodo DOI is an archive of the GitHub collection, so it is not drafted as a second dataset. Sensor rows and any performance calculations were not downloaded or reproduced.
